responsibility: Declares the visitor interfaces for traversing Rust HIR nodes. It defines the comprehensive HIRFullVisitor plus narrower visitors for impl items, types, statements, expressions, patterns, and other node families, giving each HIR class a stable double-dispatch contract for analyses, dumps, lowering-adjacent utilities, and future transformations. This file is the traversal API for the Rust HIR tree, not a node-definition or lowering implementation unit.
